blocks.text: Three of the most acclaimed performers in Philippine musical theater are coming together for Die Beautiful The Musical. IdeaFirst Live has officially announced that Audie Gemora, Karylle, and Esang de Torres are joining the cast of the highly anticipated production, set to open at the Proscenium Theater in June 2027. Widely hailed as the “King of Philippine Musical Theater,” Audie Gemora brings decades of stage excellence to the production. In Die Beautiful The Musical, Gemora will play Patricio Macapagal, the father who rejects his transgender daughter Trisha.
